voice_profile._about: โทนเสียงประจำเทมเพลต (ทำตามคลิปตัวอย่าง ประธานล้างจาน) · desc = คำสั่งออกแบบเสียง MOSS (อังกฤษ) · edge = เสียง Edge ฟรี|ระดับเสียง

narrator.desc: An adult Thai man with a deep, low, calm voice. Steady, rhythmic storytelling pace, dry and composed, never shouting.

hero.desc: A young adult man in his late twenties with a mid-range, confident, clear voice. Calm but sharp, slightly teasing, natural and expressive.

woman.desc: A Thai woman in her thirties with a high, sharp, quick-tempered voice. Fast, dramatic, scolding delivery full of attitude.

oldwoman.desc: A loud Thai woman in her fifties with a high, sharp, bossy voice. Dramatic, quick-tempered, likes to play the victim.

man.desc: An adult man with a firm, mid-range, confident voice, natural and expressive.

oldman.desc: A man in his sixties with a deep, slightly raspy, slow voice, gullible but fair.
